limitations: Frost-free-season evidence is not yet available, so its weight is zero and it does not affect suitability.
Planting windows are month-level catalog guidance; the engine cannot apply an exact two-week boundary without day-level windows.
FortyGuard one-week heat evidence is used only when the requested planting period overlaps that evidence month.
Version-one weights and thresholds are transparent engineering rules frozen for the hackathon, not statistically optimized or agronomist-certified coefficients.

method.suitability: Weighted mean of available scoreable factors, followed by explicit hard caps. Missing values are excluded, never scored as zero.
method.confidence: Weighted evidence reliability across all active factors; missing factors contribute no confidence.
